name: Ecuador

fees.name: Visa de Visitante Temporal - Turista (90 days)
fees.validity: 90 days from entry, extendable once for 90 more days (with additional fee)
fees.applies: nationalities on Ecuador's visa-required list (~45 countries incl. IND, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, CHN, AFG, CUB, VEN, VNM); most other nationalities are visa-exempt
fees.notes: Split as USD 50 application (solicitud) + USD 30 visa issuance (otorgamiento). No IVA. Applied online via the official e-Visas portal (serviciosciudadanos.cancilleria.gob.ec).

fees.name: e-Visas portal application (electronic tourist/transit visa)
fees.validity: per visa category (tourist 90 days, transit up to 30 days)
fees.notes: The e-Visas portal is Ecuador's sole application channel since 2024; fees are the standard USD 50 application + USD 30 issuance, no extra e-visa surcharge published.

fees.name: Visa de Visitante Temporal - Transeunte (transit)
fees.validity: up to 30 days, generally single entry (up to 2 entries within 30 days if transiting to/from a third country)
fees.notes: USD 50 application form + USD 30 visa fee per official tramite page.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Ecuador has no visa-on-arrival scheme; visa-required nationalities must obtain the visa in advance via the e-Visas portal, while visa-exempt visitors receive a free 90-day entry stamp.

fees.name: Business travel (short stay)
fees.notes: Ecuador does not publish a separate short-stay business visa category; short business trips fall under the temporary visitor (tourist) visa regime (USD 50 + USD 30). No distinct official business-visa fee verified.

free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, RUS and most of the Americas/Europe) are visa-exempt for up to 90 days per year (extendable 90 more) and pay no visa fee on entry. Only ~45 listed nationalities (incl. IND, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, CHN, AFG, CUB, VEN) need a pre-arranged visa; fees are flat (USD 50 + USD 30) with no reciprocity-based variation.
